records.title: Beyond Imitation: Reflective On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
records.reason: ROSD is an on-policy self-distillation/post-training objective for reasoning quality and stability; it does not reduce inference resource use.

records.title: UniDriveVLA: Unifying Understanding, Perception, and Action Planning for Autonomous Driving
records.reason: UniDriveVLA develops autonomous-driving perception/action planning; no LLM serving or inference-efficiency method is reported.

records.title: Trajectory-Informed Memory Generation for Self-Improving Agent Systems
records.reason: The method extracts tips from previous agent trajectories and retrieves them into future prompts to reduce repeated ineffective behavior. It improves task outcomes, but primary evidence does not establish reduced model calls, prompt tokens, latency, or inference cost.

records.title: Thinking in Uncertainty: Mitigating Hallucinations in MLRMs with Latent Entropy-Aware Decoding
records.reason: Latent-entropy decoding targets multimodal hallucination mitigation and answer quality; no compute, memory, latency, throughput, or serving reduction is established.

records.title: CiteAudit: You Cited It, But Did You Read It? A Benchmark for Verifying Scientific References in the LLM Era
records.reason: The paper is a citation-integrity benchmark and reference-verification system. Runtime/API-cost measurements concern citation checking, not improving LLM inference or serving.
